Counting only bounded points loses full de Rham rank.

new_proof_challenges_addressed: Are all roots in one Puiseux field? Formal Newton-Puiseux,finite ramification.
Do overlapping critical balls have equal intrinsic scale? Integral translation preserves the highest unit coefficient and criticality kills the linear term.
Does the reduction degree count root multiplicity? Factorization and multiplicativity of coefficient valuation.
Can polynomial separators grow at different balls? Finite cluster tree and sufficiently high powers of each Lagrange filter kill all finite negative coefficient valuations.
Is the Jacobian differentiated? Exact moving-volume identity includes delta_prime/delta.
Does seed1 imply a full-module quotient? First restrict to its rational differential seed submodule,then extend only after the constructed full module is semisimple.
Can equality in the valuation criterion exclude purity? No:the exact normalized quadratic at equality has constant period.
Does the polynomial theorem cover a puncture ball? No;PAPER-B-L remains open.
